segments.ja524:1.3: Kathaṃ nu vittāni pahāya bhoge, pabbaji nikkhamma gharā sapañña”[sapañño (syā.), sapaññā (pī.)].
segments.ja524:2.3: Disvāna puññāna mahāvipākaṃ, saddhāyahaṃ pabbajitomhi rāja”.
segments.ja524:3.1: “Na kāmakāmā na bhayā na dosā, vācaṃ musā pabbajitā bhaṇanti;
segments.ja524:3.3: Akkhāhi me pucchito etamatthaṃ, sutvāna me jāyihitippasādo”.
segments.ja524:4.1: “Vāṇijja [vaṇijja (pī.)] raṭṭhādhipa gacchamāno, pathe addasāsimhi bhojaputte [milācaputte (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja524:4.3: Pavaddhakāyaṃ uragaṃ mahantaṃ, ādāya gacchante pamodamāne”.
segments.ja524:5.1: “Sohaṃ samāgamma janinda tehi, pahaṭṭhalomo avacamhi bhīto;
segments.ja524:5.3: Kuhiṃ ayaṃ nīyati [niyyati (ka.)] bhīmakāyo, nāgena kiṃ kāhatha bhojaputtā.
segments.ja524:6.1: “Nāgo ayaṃ nīyati bhojanatthā [bhojanatthaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], pavaddhakāyo urago mahanto;
segments.ja524:6.3: Sāduñca thūlañca muduñca maṃsaṃ, na tvaṃ rasaññāsi videhaputta.
segments.ja524:7.1: “Ito mayaṃ gantvā sakaṃ niketaṃ [niketanaṃ (pī.)], ādāya satthāni vikopayitvā;
segments.ja524:7.3: Maṃsāni bhokkhāma [bhakkhāma (syā.)] pamodamānā, mayañhi ve sattavo pannagānaṃ.
segments.ja524:8.1: “Sace ayaṃ nīyati bhojanatthā, pavaddhakāyo urago mahanto;
segments.ja524:8.3: Dadāmi vo balibaddāni [balivaddāni (pī.)] soḷasa, nāgaṃ imaṃ muñcatha bandhanasmā.
segments.ja524:9.1: “Addhā hi no bhakkho ayaṃ manāpo, bahū ca no uragā bhuttapubbā [bahuṃ ca no urago bhuttapubbo (ka.)];
segments.ja524:9.3: Karoma te taṃ vacanaṃ aḷāra [āḷāra (ka.) evamuparipi], mittañca no hohi videhaputta.
segments.ja524:10.1: “Tadassu te bandhanā mocayiṃsu, yaṃ natthuto paṭimokkassa pāse;
segments.ja524:10.3: Mutto ca so bandhanā nāgarājā, pakkāmi pācīnamukho muhuttaṃ.
segments.ja524:11.1: “Gantvāna pācīnamukho muhuttaṃ, puṇṇehi nettehi palokayī maṃ;
segments.ja524:11.3: Tadāssahaṃ piṭṭhito anvagacchiṃ, dasaṅguliṃ añjaliṃ paggahetvā.
segments.ja524:12.1: “Gaccheva kho tvaṃ taramānarūpo, mā taṃ amittā punaraggahesuṃ;
segments.ja524:12.3: Dukkho hi luddehi punā samāgamo, adassanaṃ bhojaputtāna gaccha.
segments.ja524:13.1: “Agamāsi so rahadaṃ vippasannaṃ, nīlobhāsaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ sutitthaṃ;
segments.ja524:13.3: Samotataṃ [samonataṃ (syā. ka.)] jambuhi vetasāhi, pāvekkhi nittiṇṇabhayo patīto.
segments.ja524:14.1: “So taṃ pavissa na cirassa nāgo, dibbena me pāturahuṃ janinda;
segments.ja524:14.3: Upaṭṭhahī maṃ pitaraṃva putto, hadayaṅgamaṃ kaṇṇasukhaṃ bhaṇanto.
segments.ja524:15.1: “Tvaṃ mesi mātā ca pitā [pitā ca (pī.)] aḷāra, abbhantaro pāṇadado sahāyo;
segments.ja524:15.3: Sakañca iddhiṃ paṭilābhakosmi [paṭilābhitosmi (pī.)], aḷāra passa me nivesanāni;
segments.ja524:16.1: “Taṃ bhūmibhāgehi upetarūpaṃ, asakkharā ceva mudū subhā ca;
segments.ja524:16.3: Nīcattiṇā [nīcā tiṇā (syā. pī.)] apparajā ca bhūmi, pāsādikā yattha jahanti sokaṃ.
segments.ja524:17.3: Pakkā ca pesī ca phalā suphullā, niccotukā dhārayantī phalāni.
segments.ja524:19.1: “Maṇīmayā soṇṇamayā [sovaṇṇamayā (sī. syā. pī.)] uḷārā, anekacittā satataṃ sunimmitā;
segments.ja524:20.3: Sahassathambhaṃ atulānubhāvaṃ, yatthassa bhariyā mahesī ahosi.
segments.ja524:21.1: “Ekā ca nārī taramānarūpā, ādāya veḷuriyamayaṃ mahagghaṃ;
segments.ja524:22.1: “Tato maṃ urago hatthe gahetvā, nisīdayī pāmukhaāsanasmiṃ;
segments.ja524:22.3: Idamāsanaṃ atra bhavaṃ nisīdatu, bhavañhi me aññataro garūnaṃ.
segments.ja524:23.1: “Aññā ca nārī taramānarūpā, ādāya vāriṃ upasaṅkamitvā;
segments.ja524:23.3: Pādāni pakkhālayī me janinda, bhariyāva [bhariyā ca (pī.)] bhattū patino piyassa.
segments.ja524:24.1: “Aparā ca nārī taramānarūpā, paggayha sovaṇṇamayāya [sovaṇṇamayā (pī.)] pātiyā;
segments.ja524:24.3: Anekasūpaṃ vividhaṃ viyañjanaṃ, upanāmayī bhatta manuññarūpaṃ.
segments.ja524:25.1: “Turiyehi [tūriyehi (ka.)] maṃ bhārata bhuttavantaṃ, upaṭṭhahuṃ bhattu mano viditvā;
segments.ja524:25.3: Tatuttariṃ [taduttariṃ (ka.)] maṃ nipatī mahantaṃ, dibbehi kāmehi anappakehi.
segments.ja524:26.3: Aḷāra etāssu te kāmakārā, dadāmi te tā paricārayassu.
segments.ja524:27.1: “Saṃvaccharaṃ dibbarasānubhutvā, tadāssuhaṃ [tadassahaṃ (pī.)] uttarimajjhabhāsiṃ [uttari paccabhāsiṃ (sī. syā.), uttariṃ paccabhāsiṃ (pī.)];
segments.ja524:27.3: Nāgassidaṃ kinti kathañca laddhaṃ, kathajjhagamāsi vimānaseṭṭhaṃ”.
segments.ja524:28.1: “Adhicca laddhaṃ pariṇāmajaṃ te, sayaṃkataṃ udāhu devehi dinnaṃ;
segments.ja524:29.1: “Nādhicca laddhaṃ na pariṇāmajaṃ me, na sayaṃkataṃ nāpi devehi dinnaṃ;
segments.ja524:29.3: Sakehi kammehi apāpakehi, puññehi me laddhamidaṃ vimānaṃ”.
segments.ja524:30.1: “Kiṃ te vataṃ kiṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ, kissa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko;
segments.ja524:30.3: Akkhāhi me nāgarājetamatthaṃ, kathaṃ nu te laddhamidaṃ vimānaṃ”.
segments.ja524:31.3: So ittaraṃ jīvitaṃ saṃviditvā, asassataṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ.
segments.ja524:32.1: “Annañca pānañca pasannacitto, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ [adāsi (pī.)];
segments.ja524:32.3: Opānabhūtaṃ me gharaṃ tadāsi, santappitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca.
segments.ja524:33.1: [ayaṃ gāthā pī. potthake natthi]“Mālañca gandhañca vilepanañca, padīpiyaṃ [padīpayaṃ (syā. ka.)] yānamupassayañca;
segments.ja524:33.3: Acchādanaṃ seyyamathannapānaṃ, sakkacca dānāni adamha tattha [ayaṃ gāthā pī. potthake natthi].
segments.ja524:34.1: “Taṃ me vataṃ taṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ, tassa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko;
segments.ja524:34.3: Teneva me laddhamidaṃ vimānaṃ, pahūtabhakkhaṃ bahuannapānaṃ”;
segments.ja524:34.5: “Naccehi gītehi cupetarūpaṃ, ciraṭṭhitikaṃ na ca sassatāyaṃ.
segments.ja524:35.3: Kimeva dāṭhāvudha kiṃ paṭicca, hatthatta [hatthattha (sī. syā. pī.)] māgacchi vanibbakānaṃ [vaṇibbakānaṃ (sī.)].
segments.ja524:36.1: “Bhayaṃ nu te anvagataṃ mahantaṃ, tejo nu te nānvagaṃ dantamūlaṃ;
segments.ja524:36.3: Kimeva dāṭhāvudha kiṃ paṭicca, kilesamāpajji vanibbakānaṃ”.
segments.ja524:37.1: “Na me bhayaṃ anvagataṃ mahantaṃ, tejo na sakkā mama tehi hantuṃ [tebhihantuṃ (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja524:38.3: Athāgamuṃ soḷasa bhojaputtā, rajjuṃ gahetvāna daḷhañca pāsaṃ.
segments.ja524:39.1: “Bhetvāna nāsaṃ atikassa [antakassa (ka.)] rajjuṃ, nayiṃsu maṃ samparigayha luddā;
segments.ja524:40.1: “Ekāyane taṃ pathe addasaṃsu, balena vaṇṇena cupetarūpaṃ;
segments.ja524:40.3: Siriyā paññāya ca bhāvitosi, kiṃ patthayaṃ [kimatthiyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] nāga tapo karosi.
segments.ja524:41.1: “Na puttahetū na dhanassa hetu, na āyuno cāpi aḷāra hetu;
segments.ja524:41.3: Manussayoniṃ abhipatthayāno, tasmā parakkamma tapo karomi”.
segments.ja524:43.3: Pucchāmi taṃ nāgarājetamatthaṃ, seyyo ito kena manussaloko”.
segments.ja524:44.1: “Aḷāra nāññatra manussalokā, suddhī va saṃvijjati saṃyamo vā;
segments.ja524:44.3: Ahañca laddhāna manussayoniṃ, kāhāmi jātimaraṇassa antaṃ”.
segments.ja524:45.1: “Saṃvaccharo me vasato [vusito (pī.)] tavantike, annena pānena upaṭṭhitosmi;
segments.ja524:45.3: Āmantayitvāna palemi nāga, cirappavuṭṭhosmi [cirappavuttho asmi (pī.)] ahaṃ janinda”.
segments.ja524:46.1: “Puttā ca dārā anujīvino ca [ca’ nujīvino (syā. pī.)], niccānusiṭṭhā upatiṭṭhate taṃ;
segments.ja524:46.3: Kaccinnu taṃ nābhisapittha [nābhisaṃsittha (syā. pī.)] koci, piyañhi me dassanaṃ tuyhaṃ [tuyha (pī.)] aḷāra”.
segments.ja524:47.1: “Yathāpi mātū ca pitū agāre, putto piyo paṭivihito vaseyya [seyyo (pī.)];
segments.ja524:47.3: Tatopi mayhaṃ idhameva seyyo, cittañhi te nāga mayī pasannaṃ”.
segments.ja524:48.1: “Maṇī mamaṃ vijjati lohitaṅko [lohitaṅgo (ka.)], dhanāharo maṇiratanaṃ uḷāraṃ;
segments.ja524:48.3: Ādāya tvaṃ [taṃ (pī.)] gaccha sakaṃ niketaṃ, laddhā dhanaṃ taṃ maṇimossajassu”.
segments.ja524:49.3: Ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā, saddhāyahaṃ pabbajitomhi rāja.
segments.ja524:50.1: “Dumapphalānīva patanti māṇavā, daharā ca vuddhā ca sarīrabhedā;
segments.ja524:50.3: Etampi disvā pabbajitomhi rāja, apaṇṇakaṃ sāmaññameva seyyo”.
segments.ja524:51.1: “Addhā have sevitabbā sapaññā, bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino;
segments.ja524:51.3: Nāgañca sutvāna tavañcaḷāra, kāhāmi puññāni anappakāni”.
segments.ja524:52.1: “Addhā have sevitabbā sapaññā, bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino;
segments.ja524:52.3: Nāgañca sutvāna mamañca rāja, karohi puññāni anappakānī”ti.
